changelog.entry: Stranded opens: a branching text conversation with Ines, a stubborn, funny field engineer alone on a small moon. Twelve days, fifty-nine scenes, nine endings, and every reply gets an answer. Rewind to any of your messages for free, and nothing you found or tried is ever lost. Nothing is timed: replies appear at once, or one at a time when you tap. Trust, Supplies and Hope are always in view.
